name: Ethereal Booking
author: manuelzela

sections.description:
Ethereal Booking turns your WordPress website into a booking website for a room, an apartment, a villa or any rental. Guests book directly on your website, and the calendar stays in sync with Booking.com and Airbnb, so the same dates are never sold twice.

Features

  • Booking.com and Airbnb sync (iCal): bookings from the platforms block the dates on your website, and website bookings block them on the platforms.
  • 3-step booking form: Dates → Details → Confirm, on phone, tablet and computer.
  • Payments: pay at the property or by bank transfer (the bank details are sent to the guest).
  • Property page: gallery with lightbox, details, prices and the availability calendar – nothing to set up.
  • Rooms page with search: dates, guests and type, only free dates with the total price.
  • Automatic emails for you and the guest: request, confirmation, payment, cancellation.
  • 4 languages: English, Shqip, Italiano, Deutsch, for guests and for the admin.
  • Shortcodes to show the search bar, the properties grid or the booking form on any page.
  • No commission, no account, no tracking: the bookings and the guests are yours.

Ethereal Booking Pro

Everything in Ethereal Booking is free and works without limits, for any number of properties. A separate plugin, Ethereal Booking Pro (not included here), adds:

  • Card (Stripe) and PayPal payments inside the booking form, the full amount or a deposit
  • The calendar of all properties on one timeline
  • Editable email templates
  • Updates and email support

Ethereal Booking Pro is available at plugins.etherealwebsolution.com. It is installed next to this plugin; your properties, bookings and settings stay as they are.

Who makes this

Ethereal Booking is developed by Manuel Zela at Ethereal Web Solution. Support: info@etherealwebsolution.com.

Shortcodes

  • [ethebo_search] – search bar anywhere; results open on /accommodation/.
  • [ethebo_properties] – grid of the properties with the search bar on top. Options: search="no" limit="6" columns="3" type="apartment".
  • [ethebo_booking id="123"] – calendar and booking form for one property.

External services

This plugin connects to other websites only for the calendar sync:

  • Booking.com, Airbnb or any iCal calendar – the plugin downloads the iCal links you paste on a property (to block the dates booked there), and those platforms download your property’s iCal link (to block the dates booked on your website). The iCal data contains only dates and a booking reference. Booking.com: Terms · Privacy. Airbnb: Terms · Privacy.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Ethereal Booking”, then Install and Activate.
  2. A new Accommodation menu appears. Add your property: photos, price per night, guests.
  3. On the property, the “Sync with Booking.com / Airbnb” box shows how to connect the platforms.
  4. In Accommodation → Payments turn on “Pay at the property” and / or “Bank transfer”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Booking.com or Airbnb account?

No. The plugin also works with your website only. If you have one, connect it with the iCal link the platform gives you.

How fast is the sync?

Your website imports every 15–30 minutes and right before every booking. Booking.com and Airbnb read your calendar every 1–3 hours (their limit). For sync without visitors, add the server cron link from Settings → Sync to your hosting.

Can I take card payments?

Guests can pay at the property or by bank transfer. Card (Stripe) and PayPal payments inside the booking form are part of Ethereal Booking Pro.

I have more than one room

Add each room as its own property, as many as you need. Each one has its own calendar and its own Booking.com / Airbnb sync.

Does the plugin contact other websites?

Only the calendar links you paste (Booking.com, Airbnb or any iCal calendar). See “External services” below.
